links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of five LLMs compared on the same neurosurgical vignettes
links.effect: ChatGPT-4 74% correct, AtlasGPT 63%, ChatGPT-3.5 53%, Microsoft Copilot 48%, Gemini 36%; ChatGPT-4 more accurate than counterparts (p = 0.005).
links.quote: Chi-square comparisons demonstrated that ChatGPT-4 was more accurate in providing clinical diagnoses than its counterparts (p = 0.005).

screen.reason: The study evaluates the diagnostic performance and error modes of multiple LLMs on 148 neurosurgery clinical vignettes extracted from a textbook, but does not test a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
